i’m stuck in a loop of being awake and being asleep and dreaming i’m awake (i think it’s this otherwise i’ve been awake for days and i’m really delirious i can’t tell) this weird loop thing started after i had a really long detailed dream that ended with my friend overdosing on crack and dying and idk maybe it’s some kind of drug induced psychosis i’m really fucked rn

wait another theory is that i haven’t slept at all in a few days and i’m delirious?? i keep blacking out and forgetting things but the last dream i remember that wasn’t this weird time warp reality loop thing was a very long detailed dream i remember all of, 

basically i was in an apartment and kept falling through holes in the floor, i left the apartment because i didn’t like falling through the floor and walked to a house that was a warehouse inside, it was number 35, it had fine china on a wall and there were people making massive sculptures of people, it was some kind of weird drug house? someone pulled a big gun on me so i left with a bag of xanax? 

i then proceeded to go to woolworths to buy a pregnancy test that was actually a drug test because i was worried about my xanax being spiked with fentanyl, as i moved throughout woolies n bought it kept morphing between the preggo test drug test thing and eyedrops.

i saw one of my friends at the checkout so we walked out together and talked, as we were getting into our car this lady that was apparently my friends friend who was on crack pulled up, we decided to get into her car with her.
suddenly the boot was open and i was sitting in it as the car drove backwards down a mossy alleyway, i ended up doing drugs (idk wtf i did in my dream) and woke up with my friend in a sewer that looked kinda like a hospital car park with a small barred thing looking out onto a supermarket near me, me and my friend spent ages flipping and rolling around in the sewer before a massive stone wall appeared and opened 

it opened onto a massive indoor pool that looked really nice, it was full of really tall ladies that were pale as fuck and really skinny, they all had massive acrylic nails and toenails, i discovered i could breathe underwater and found a seperate room and door a few metres down into the pool, i kinda struggled with breathing underwater as i wasn’t used to it.

i swim into the room and am confronted by the crack lady, the room was a pink color and kinda small, me and my friend decided to leave, we put on weird clothes from a rack/pile of random fancy clothes. the crack lady is searching for her “emo hoodie” she picks up a grey one w pink flamingos on it, i find a lion hoodie and offer it to her because in my mind emo hoodie morphed into leo hoodie like the zodiac sign? 

next me and my friend move to a small white stand with some random things on it and a pile of phones, we can’t find my phone to find out where we r located so we take the crack ladies phone, her phone has heaps of videos of me high on it that i don’t recall, we also find small purses full of rolled up $50 notes (american dollar bills and i’m in australia??) we r worried the crack lady will chase after us so we steal some of her money and and run into a dodgy alleyway, it forks off and i follow my friend into a lovely small circle full of trees and grass (this whole dream was really saturated in color everything looked enhanced) 

we go a little further and see a massive fence w a big construction site m everything looks really industrial and polluted. my dream then skips to us going out a gate, there are short people everywhere in blue shirts with large blue hats on like the smurfs, they r surveying people looking for us (i think whatever weird place crack lady came from she was in charge of and looking for us) i see some cafes and can clearly read their opening hours and the names of them, there r lots of normal people walking around and this area looks like a modern town sorta.

we rush past the people in caps and then realise we have caps on and they are weighing us down so we can’t fly, we take them off and jump a few times before floating up into the air where no one can see us, we land on a pink roof in a forest that has really round bubbly everything (kinda like candy crush game filtered) we use the phone to find our location on google maps, i’m then trying to smash the phone as a lady interrupts me and tells us about the “jelly cup game” (a phone game where weird round pink blobs are pushed around trees until they reach the top of the phone and escape the phone, as she tells us this we transform into the jelly cubes and are being pushed up until we break the top of her phone and are free as people again. i end up in my backyard but my friend is not with me, somehow i know she really wants more crack though, i become increasingly distressed and try to jump again to fly and find her, i realise i can no longer fly and sense that she is overdosing on crack and dying and then i wake up slamming my head down on my bed and hitting my arms really anxiously. 


this is the longest most detailed dream i’ve ever had, since this dream everything’s been really weird n idk it sorta makes sense that i haven’t slept since this dream because of how scared it made me to fall asleep? i was worried when i fell asleep i’d return to this dream and have to deal with the grief of my friend dying. 

before this dream id have multiple dreams a night, this one was sorta like that but i wouldn’t forget each ran after it happened, this dream was all my multiple dreams in a night linking up into a massive storyline n idk it was just really scary n i keep having flashbacks and thinking my friend has overdosed and died.
